exposure: Insulin-like growth factor binding protein-1 (IGFBP-1) concentrations
cohort: The study included 35 nulliparous women with singleton pregnancies, intact amniotic membranes, and cephalic presentation at >=40 gestational weeks, who were scheduled for labour induction by Foley catheter.
finding: Although IGFBP-1 and phIGFBP-1 concentrations increased, and MMP-8 and MMP-9 concentrations decreased during Foley catheter-induced cervical ripening, these changes did not predict the outcome of labour induction.
mod_finding: Changes in cervical IGFBP-1, phIGFBP-1, MMP-8, and MMP-9 concentrations did not predict vaginal delivery after Foley catheter induction.
